observations: The opening retains personal permission, losing the way midway, and the North Star. It does not turn permission into a command to dream.
The gathering is repeated; the world is pressed to the chest; ألمّ شتاته gives joining a scattered whole an intelligible Arabic expression.
خزّاف keeps the potter. Clay is an explicit inference from that trade. أزرع ابتسامة preserves sowing a smile.
The invitation, mountains, moon and shoulders beside clouds remain. سرّ الهطول مطراً renders the rain-mantra as a secret of falling rain, without introducing worship.
أنسج أحلامك في أحلامي preserves whose dreams enter whose.
arabic.decision: Retain. The poetic images are intelligible; no clear meaning repair identified in this reading.
arabic.follow_up: A fluent Modern Standard Arabic reader should check the gathering breath and the idiom of كتفاً إلى كتف مع الغيوم. Selective vocalization should follow an actual pronunciation review, not a blanket addition.

observations: মাজবাটত keeps midway; the star remains the guide.
বুটলি repeats the collecting action before the close embrace and the two hopes.
কুমাৰ retains the potter; হাঁহি ফুলাবলৈ uses the project-permitted blooming-smile adaptation.
The mountain, moon, shoulder and rain-mantra sequence survives in the invitation.
The ending joins your dreams with mine without adding a promise of fulfilment.
assamese.decision: Retain; do not replace Assamese forms with Bengali cognates.
assamese.follow_up: Native Assamese review: ৰঙেৰে বোলাই as a hanging participial phrase, and the breath and idiom of বৰষুণ হৈ সৰাৰ. No replacement is asserted here.

observations: The opening preserves permission and becoming lost on the way; পথের মাঝে keeps the road's middle.
কুড়িয়ে and বুকে জড়িয়ে রেখেছি preserve gathering and sustained closeness, followed by joining and adorning.
কুমোর is the potter; হাসি ফোটাতে is the permitted blooming-smile adaptation.
The invitation keeps all four images and the rain-mantra.
স্বপ্ন আমার স্বপ্নের সঙ্গে বুনে gives weaving together rather than explicitly into; this is a small lyrical choice, not a reversal of participants.
bengali.decision: Retain the recorded lyric. No confident corrective rewrite is warranted by this text review.
bengali.follow_up: A Bengali reader can assess the fragment রঙে রাঙিয়ে and whether সঙ্গে বুনে is the desired ending. Any later textual change must be reconciled with the recording.

observations: हमरा and बीच राह keep the speaker and road relationship. The female bridge is an approved arrangement, not an extra character in the source.
बटोरत and छाती से लगवले retain gathering and holding the world close, then its joining and beautifying.
कुम्हार preserves the role; हँसी खिलावे uses the accepted blooming smile.
The female invitation retains mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
तोहार सपना अपना सपना में keeps the addressee's dreams entering the speaking voice's dreams.
bhojpuri.decision: Retain the selected duet arrangement and words.
bhojpuri.follow_up: Bhojpuri review should address local register and respectful/intimate forms such as आवऽ, चढ़ीं and बानी together. Do not normalize them into Hindi or infer a grammatical fault merely from their mixture. Check each released variation against its own submitted lyrics separately.

observations: अद्ध बाटै names the halfway setting and ध्रुव तारा remains the guide.
The repeated gathering, world held to the chest, and joining/beautifying hopes are represented.
कुम्हार keeps the maker and हस्सी खिड़ाना is the allowed flowering-smile choice.
The bridge retains climbing, moon-gazing, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
The ending retains your dreams woven into the speaker's own dreams.
dogri.decision: Retain provisionally; semantic coverage is present, but this is not a Dogri fluency clearance.
dogri.follow_up: Prioritize a Dogri literary reader for हिक्कै कन्नै, दिक्खचै/चढ़चै and the agreement in दुनिया गी ... रक्खी ऐ. Their naturalness should not be decided by Hindi resemblance.

observations: The affirmative freedom refrain carries the Odia permission naturally. 'Free to lose my way' omits the explicit midway setting.
'Piece by piece' avoids the author-disliked repeated 'Gathering, gathering'; gathering into the arms and the two hopes remain.
Potter, form, colour and sowing a smile survive without a replacement grander creator.
Mountains, moon and shoulders beside clouds remain; 'learn to fall as rain' condenses the mantra to an action.
'Thread by thread' is a musical addition, and 'with mine' is weaving together rather than explicitly into mine. Both belong to the established adaptation.
english.decision: Retain the author-selected country/jazz lyric as expressly directed in its language page. These are documented song choices, not grounds to silently rewrite the published words.
english.follow_up: If a separate literary edition is wanted, consider 'free to lose my way midway' only in a fresh full-line revision; it is not applied to this song. Keep the North Star and the ordinary potter.

observations: Malaya akong mangarap is an affirmative freedom opening. Sa gitna ng paglalakbay and Tala sa Hilaga retain the journey's middle and North Star, despite a rearranged intro.
Tinitipon and Yakap kong mahigpit keep gathering and the close embrace, followed by the two hopes.
Magpapalayok and magpunla ng ngiti retain the potter and sowing a smile.
Mountains, moon and rain remain. Makisabay sa mga ulap conveys accompanying or moving with clouds, but the shoulder-to-shoulder image is no longer explicit.
The final chorus keeps dreams woven into dreams. Dahan-dahan adds slowness in the outro, a musical choice rather than source wording.
filipino.decision: Retain recorded words; flag the cloud line for a considered Filipino revision rather than supplying an unverified literal shoulder calque.
filipino.follow_up: Ask a Filipino poet for a natural shoulder-to-shoulder cloud line that fits the existing phrase length. Confirm it before any replacement recording or revised displayed lyric.

observations: The refrain is natural French permission/freedom. 'En chemin' means along the way and drops the source's midway detail; change it to 'à mi-chemin' in intro and chorus.
Je recueille ... le monde et le serre contre moi retains gathering and holding close. The shared subject after et is valid; do not invent a missing-pronoun error.
Potier, giving form/colour and semer un sourire keep the source's creative acts.
The invitation preserves mountain, moon and cloud shoulders. Secret and tomber en pluie are poetic renderings of the rain-mantra.
Tisser tes rêves dans les miens retains the inward weaving direction.
french.decision: Apply the limited midway fidelity edit. Keep the rest.
french.follow_up: French sung review remains open, particularly Épaule contre épaule avec les nuages. Potier selects a male speaker for the current male-led arrangement; it does not prove the original speaker's gender.

observations: અધવચ્ચે explicitly retains midway; the star guides.
વીણતાં repeats collecting; હૈયે વળગાડી retains the embrace and the hopes remain.
કુંભાર, shaping and colouring remain; સ્મિત ખીલવતાં is the allowed blooming adaptation.
The invitation keeps hills, moon, shoulder contact with clouds, and learning rain's mantra.
The ending keeps the addressee's dreams woven into the speaker's.
gujarati.decision: Retain. The masculine શીખ્યો belongs to this male-led adaptation, not to a source-established gender.
gujarati.follow_up: Gujarati speaker to check the collected-world participle and સપનાં/સપનામાં number in context. Do not import Hindi agreement or mechanically force every dream noun into the same surface form.

observations: मनाही कोन्या and बीच रस्ते retain freedom and the middle of the road.
समेट कै and छाती तै ला राखी retain collecting and holding; the two hopes remain.
कुम्हार keeps the potter and हँसी खिलाणी is the allowed blooming smile.
The invitation retains mountain, moon, shoulders with clouds and rain-mantra.
पिरोण keeps threading dreams into dreams.
haryanvi.decision: Retain provisionally; do not replace the local forms with standard Hindi.
haryanvi.follow_up: Native Haryanvi review of register, देणा/खिलाणी agreement, and सपन्यां is still needed. Semantic readability by a related-language reader is not dialect validation.

observations: Personal permission, बीच राह and the guiding star all remain.
समेटते repeats gathering; दुनिया को सीने से लगा रखा है keeps holding it close and both hopes.
Potter, shaping and colour remain. मुस्कान खिलाना is explicitly allowed by the meaning guide; do not call it a mistranslation merely because the original sows.
The four invitation images and मंत्र remain. There is no need to make the passage more devotional.
तुम्हारे सपनों को अपने सपनों में पिरोने retains threading the addressee's dreams into the speaker's.
hindi.decision: Retain. No clear correction identified; a more Sanskritized version would not improve fidelity.
hindi.follow_up: The colour participle can be assessed in performance for a complete thought. This review does not establish sung diction or pause quality.

observations: A metà del cammino preserves midway and Stella Polare remains the guide.
Raccolgo repeats gathering; stringo a me is a close embrace; joining and making beautiful remain hopes.
Vasaio, form, colour and seminare un sorriso retain the creative sequence.
Fianco a fianco uses side by side rather than literal shoulders; it naturally preserves companionship with clouds. Mountain, moon and rain remain.
Intrecciare i tuoi sogni ai miei preserves interweaving, with the established refrain repetitions.
italian.follow_up: Libero and vasaio choose a masculine speaking voice for this arrangement. A female-led alternative would need its own agreement pass; do not infer the beloved's gender.

observations: ನಡುದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ keeps the middle of the road and the star guides.
ಒಂದೊಂದಾಗಿ means one by one, but the next line moves straight to embracing the world; no collecting verb is stated. Restore a repeated collecting action with ಕೂಡಿಸುತ್ತಾ... ಕೂಡಿಸುತ್ತಾ....
ಕುಂಬಾರ keeps the potter; shaping and colour remain; ನಗು ಅರಳಿಸಲು is the allowed blooming-smile adaptation.
Mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra remain in the invitation.
ಹೆಣೆಯಲೂ keeps weaving the addressee's dreams with the speaker's.
kannada.decision: Apply the gathering repair in the lyric and its exact quoted style instruction, retaining the breath. Keep the rest.
kannada.follow_up: The revised collecting verb needs a native Kannada poetic/cadence review before recording. This is a targeted model revision, not a fluent-speaker certification.

observations: The freedom, straying and star are represented, but वाटेर वाट gives on-the-road wording without an explicit midway marker.
वेंचून and काळजाशी धरला preserve gathering and close holding; joining and beautifying remain hopes.
कुंभार remains the potter; flowering laughter/smile is the permitted lyrical choice.
The invitation keeps mountains, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
गुंफपाकय retains the final weaving into the speaker's dreams.
konkani.decision: Retain provisionally. A midway repair should be made in the chosen Konkani variety rather than by importing Marathi or Hindi wording.
konkani.follow_up: Prioritize a Devanagari Konkani reader: confirm verb forms शिकलां, the address/invitation, and a natural midway phrase. Do not claim these forms are incorrect without that review.

observations: आध बाटमे keeps halfway and the North Star guides.
समेटैत and छातीसँ लगा रखने keep gathering and holding close, followed by the two hopes.
कुम्हार preserves the role; हँसी फुलाएब is the allowed blooming-smile adaptation.
The invitation preserves mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
अहाँक सपना अपन सपनामे retains whose dreams are woven into whose; अहाँ maintains respectful address.
maithili.decision: Retain provisionally; preserve Maithili rather than smoothing into Hindi.
maithili.follow_up: Native review of सजेबाक, the invitation's verb endings and the chosen respectful register remains open. These are questions, not confirmed errors.

observations: പാതിവഴിയിൽ keeps halfway; the star guides.
പെറുക്കി repeats gathering and മാറോടണച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു holds the world to the chest; both hopes remain.
കുശവൻ is the potter; പുഞ്ചിരി വിരിയിക്കാൻ is the permitted blooming smile.
നിലാവ് evokes moonlight rather than naming the moon alone, a natural local poetic choice. Mountains, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra remain.
ഇഴചേർക്കാനും retains the intertwining of dreams.
malayalam.follow_up: The shifts between നിൻ and നിന്റെ are literary short/full forms, not automatically a register error. A fluent Malayalam reader should check the long potter sentence in the sung phrase.

observations: The freedom construction is clear and 半途 preserves midway; 北极星 is retained.
一点一点 repeats the gradual collecting, with 收拢 explicitly gathering and 紧紧抱在怀里 holding tight. Both hopes remain.
陶匠, shaping, colour and 种下一抹微笑 retain potter and sowing.
Mountains, moon and shoulders with clouds remain. The rain line omits the mantra/secret and adds 轻轻, gently: a musical softening, not literal source wording.
织进我的梦里 keeps the dreams woven into the speaker's.
mandarin.decision: Retain. Do not turn every musical condensation into a defect.
mandarin.follow_up: For a future closer literary version, consider whether to restore learning rain's secret. Have a Mandarin poet assess it in the whole bridge rather than adding explanatory language to this song.

observations: वाटेत means on the way, dropping the explicit halfway position. Restore अर्ध्या वाटेत in the intro and chorus.
वेचत and उराशी कवटाळलं retain gathering and holding close; joining and adorning remain hopes.
कुंभार is retained and हसू फुलवायला is the allowed blooming-smile choice.
The invitation keeps mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
गुंफायलाही retains weaving into the speaker's dreams.
marathi.decision: Apply the limited halfway repair. Keep the regional lyric character.
marathi.follow_up: शिकलो selects a masculine speaker for this arrangement. Native Marathi cadence review of the slightly lengthened refrain remains open.

observations: बीच बाटोमै and the guiding star preserve the opening relation.
बटुल्दै repeats gathering and छातीमा अँगालेको holds the world close, with the two hopes.
कुमाले, form and colour remain; मुस्कान फुलाउन is the allowed blooming smile.
Mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra remain.
उन्न carries stringing/weaving the addressee's dreams with the speaker's.
nepali.decision: Retain. No confident textual repair identified in this reading.
nepali.follow_up: A Nepali literary reader should assess छातीमा अँगालेको and सपनासँग उन्न as full phrases, including their sung cadence. These are review priorities, not established mistakes.

observations: No meio do caminho preserves midway and the Pole Star guides.
Recolho repeats gathering; joining its parts makes the implied gathering understandable. The embrace is retained, though less explicitly tight.
Oleiro and semear um sorriso keep potter and sowing. Barro is an explicit inference from the trade.
The mountain/moon/cloud-shoulder sequence remains; segredo renders mantra without adding a religious frame.
Entrelaçar seus sonhos nos meus keeps the inward weaving direction.
portuguese.decision: Retain the broadly Brazilian phrasing; no systematic switch to European Portuguese.
portuguese.follow_up: Check Vem with seu in the intended Brazilian voice; it is not automatically an error to repair by imposing another variety. A Portuguese poet can assess the collecting refrain before recording.

observations: ਅੱਧ ਰਾਹੇ keeps halfway; the star guides.
ਸਮੇਟਦਿਆਂ and ਹਿੱਕ ਨਾਲ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੋਇਆ retain gathering and holding close; both hopes remain.
ਘੁਮਿਆਰ keeps the potter; ਹਾਸਾ ਖਿੜਾਉਣਾ is the allowed blooming smile.
The invitation retains mountains, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
ਪਰੋਣ keeps threading the beloved's dreams into the speaker's.
punjabi.follow_up: A Punjabi reader should assess the contemporary register across ਹਾਂ/ਏ and the potter wording. Do not replace Punjabi vocabulary just because a Hindi cognate seems more familiar.

observations: ମଝି ବାଟେ retains midway; the star shows the way.
ସାଉଁଟି is repeated with the agreed breath; ଜାବ୍‌ଡ଼ି ଧରିଛେଁ retains the close embrace and both hopes.
କୁମ୍ଭାର୍ ମୁଇଁ keeps the potter and full pause. ହସ୍ ବୁନ୍‌ବାର୍ retains sowing rather than replacing it with generic happiness.
The invitation keeps mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra in locally inflected forms.
ତୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌କେ ମୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌ନେ preserves the final direction of weaving.
sambalpuri.decision: Retain the author-selected local wording and limited vocal directions; do not normalize it to standard Odia.
sambalpuri.follow_up: A Sambalpuri/Kosali reader should validate the chosen regional forms and spelling, including ଦେଖେଇଦେବା and ଝର୍‌ବାର୍. The solo and playful releases still need take-specific sung-text checks; this base-page reading is not that check.

observations: मार्गाद् विचलितुम् says to stray from the path, but no longer specifies midway. Permission and guiding star remain.
सञ्चित्य repeats gathering; दृढमालिङ्गितं preserves the strong embrace. The two compound hope phrases retain joining and adornment.
कुम्भकार and स्मितं वप्तुं preserve potter and sowing. शिक्षितोऽहम् chooses a masculine speaker in this arrangement.
The bridge intends an invitation to two people and preserves mountain, moon, shoulder and rain-mantra.
गुम्फितुम् with तव ... मम स्वप्नेषु retains the weaving direction.
sanskrit.decision: Retain provisionally; do not perform speculative Sanskrit grammar repairs.
sanskrit.follow_up: Prioritize a Sanskrit specialist for सहांसं संयोज्य, dual invitation forms आरोहाव/पश्याव/शिक्षावहै, and a natural midway restoration. Their presence is not itself proof of a grammatical defect. No strict metrical form was claimed or tested.

observations: اڌ واٽ retains halfway; قطب تارو keeps the star.
Repeated gathering and holding the world to the chest survive alongside the two hopes.
ڪنڀر preserves the potter; the flowering smile is an allowed adaptation.
The invitation retains mountains, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
اُڻڻ preserves weaving the addressee's dreams into the speaker's own.
sindhi.decision: Retain provisionally; semantic comparison does not certify Sindhi idiom.
sindhi.follow_up: Native Sindhi review of ميڙيندي, agreement in لائي رکيو اٿم and the weaving verb is needed. Preserve the Sindhi script rather than normalizing it to Urdu.

observations: A mitad del camino explicitly retains midway; the Pole Star guides.
Recojo and abrazo preserve gathering and embracing; joining and beautifying are hopes, not completed achievements.
Alfarero and sembrar una sonrisa keep potter and sowing. Barro makes the trade's material explicit.
The invitation retains mountains, moon and shoulders beside clouds; secreto is a natural condensation of the rain-mantra.
Entretejer tus sueños con los míos retains mutual weaving without reversing the participants.
spanish.decision: Retain; no clear corrective rewrite is needed.
spanish.follow_up: The repeated Recojo is intentionally fragmentary until its object arrives. Native poetic and sung review can assess it without deleting the gathering breath. Alfarero follows the male-led arrangement.

observations: The opening retains freedom and getting lost, but njiani says on the way rather than explicitly midway. The North Star is retained as a source image.
Naukusanya repeats gathering; naukumbatia holds the world, followed by joining and beautifying hopes.
Mfinyanzi and kupanda tabasamu preserve potter and sowing a smile.
Mountains, moon and cloud shoulders remain; siri renders the rain-mantra as a secret.
Ndoto zako ndani ya ndoto zangu keeps the addressee's dreams inside the speaker's.
swahili.decision: Retain provisionally; do not replace the North Star to relocate the poem geographically.
swahili.follow_up: A Kiswahili reader should propose a natural midway phrase and check noun-class agreement/verb prefixes in the gathering stanza and kuzisuka ndoto. No speculative prefix correction is applied.

observations: நடுவழியில் retains midway and the star guides; title/opening word order differs naturally without changing meaning.
சிறிது சிறிதாய்ச் சேர்த்து conveys gathering bit by bit; இறுக அணைத்திருக்கிறேன் holds the world tightly and both hopes survive.
The potter declaration retains its separate breath; புன்னகை விதைக்க keeps sowing a smile.
The bridge keeps mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
பின்னிச் சேர்க்க retains weaving the addressee's dreams with the speaker's.
tamil.decision: Retain the existing Tamil words and blank line after the potter. Do not force the chosen tune into a new line length.
tamil.follow_up: A fluent listener should check the complete delivery of புன்னகை விதைக்கக் கற்றிருக்கிறேன் in each selected take. This text review has not heard or certified the solo or duet.

observations: నడిదారిలో retains midway. దారి తప్పినా makes the permission 'even if I lose my way', a slight conditional recasting that preserves allowance rather than forbidding loss.
ఏరుకుంటూ repeats gathering and గుండెలకు హత్తుకున్నాను holds the world close, followed by both hopes.
కుమ్మరిని preserves the potter; చిరునవ్వులు పూయించడం is the allowed blooming-smile adaptation.
The invitation retains hills, the affectionate జాబిల్లి moon, cloud shoulders and rain-mantra.
అల్లుకోవడానికి keeps weaving the addressee's dreams with the speaker's.
telugu.decision: Retain the selected text; do not flatten జాబిల్లి into a mechanically literal moon term.
telugu.follow_up: Keep recorded pauses and the full potter declaration. A fluent sung-delivery review is still separate from this semantic reading.

observations: Personal permission, بیچ راہ and the guiding star remain. The opening's inversion is a poetic word-order choice, not automatically a grammatical error.
سمیٹتے and سینے سے لگا رکھا retain gathering and holding the world close; both hopes remain.
کمہار, صورت گری, colour and مسکراہٹ بونا retain potter and sowing.
The invitation retains mountain, moon, cloud shoulders and منتر. The culturally retained word need not be replaced with an Islamic devotional term.
پرونا keeps threading the addressee's dreams into the speaker's own.
urdu.decision: Retain; avoid a bureaucratic ممانعت rewrite solely to regularize the refrain.
urdu.follow_up: A fluent Urdu poetry reader should assess خواب دیکھنا مجھے منع نہیں in the intended nazm register and the participial line رنگ بھر کر. Do not automatically Persianize a plain intimate voice.
